purpose.summary: ZFAM004 is a CICS online program that handles HTTP GET requests for the z/OS File Access Manager (zFAM) framework. It processes GE (greater-than-or-equal) and GT (greater-than) browse operations against a zFAM key/file structure, as well as 'ex' (existence check) queries. It reads the KEY and FILE VSAM structures, stages the response data, and returns appropriate HTTP status codes (200, 204, 507) to the caller.

notable_features: EXEC CICS (READ, LINK, and implied WEB commands)
DFHCOMMAREA linkage for inter-program communication via XCTL/LINK
USAGE POINTER with REDEFINES for dynamic storage addressing
COPY statements for ZFAMFKC and ZFAMFFC copybooks
GTEQ read option for VSAM browse-like access
